_comment: Citation for the 10e Leviathan Tournament Companion primary scoring cap: each army may score at most 15 Primary VP per battle round (≤ 3 objectives counted at 5 VP each). Wahapedia source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/leviathan-tournament-companion/

simulator.primary_vp_cap_15.quoted_text: At the end of each battle round, if you control one or more objective markers, you score 5 victory points for each objective marker you control, to a maximum of 15 victory points.
simulator.primary_vp_cap_15.trigger: end of each battle round, when totalling Primary VP for an army
simulator.primary_vp_cap_15.effect: the army's Primary VP for that round is capped at 15 (i.e. only the first 3 controlled objectives count at 5 VP each)
